acceptanceCriteria: Every feedback-0001 item has a traceable disposition, source-preserving style rule, exact prompt clause, and validation probe in feedback-resolution.json.
palette_tone separately models and evaluates source-relative skin, hair, and clothing treatments; no good global palette score may hide a missing semantic-region treatment.
graphic_language conditionally models lettering and dialogue treatment, applies it only to supplied optional text, and never copies teacher wording or language.
The final prompt is self-contained text, preserves arbitrary source identity and content, and requires no target or style-reference image at generation time.
Every generation receives exactly one source_reference image; target/style truth remains analysis-and-judge-only.
Frozen validation and a fresh one-shot sealed test prove baseline transfer and optional pose, composition, and exact-text adherence.
All generation and judge models, prompts, hashes, semantic-region losses, typography loss, and arithmetic are persisted.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool.
Treat train-0008 prompt, analyses, evaluation, and judge evidence as research evidence, not as unquestioned truth.
Do not modify prior iteration evidence.
Target/style truth is analysis-and-judge-only and forbidden as a generation input.
Do not open validationManifest before validate-transferability.
Do not open sealedTestManifest before audit-generalization.
Do not compare style-inversion-v3 losses numerically with style-inversion-v2 or earlier versions.
workflowInput.requestedWork: Continue style-prompt inversion from train-0008 using its recorded evidence and feedback-0001.
